'''Vaporeon''' (Japanese: '''シャワーズ''' ''Showers'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} who appeared in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==History==
Vaporeon debuts in ''[[PPPB10|The Master Plan... for Romance!]]'' where a {{MPJ|Machamp}} falls in love with her. She also loves {{MPJ|Machamp}}, but doesn't know that he loves her. Vaporeon later finds out about [[Machamp_(MPJ)|Machamp]]'s feelings in [[PPPB15|Loves Me? Loves Me Not?]] and they go out on a date together.
